messages.content: Translate one natural-language POLICY directly into a final Boolean policy program over only the supplied ATOMS. Each inner array is a conjunction, the outer array is OR, and !atom means negation. violation_clauses describe exactly when the policy is violated; permission_clauses describe explicit permission. Preserve actor, resource, identity, source, temporal, exception, necessary-versus-sufficient, and cardinality distinctions. Do not infer completion or effects from an action name. Return only the exact JSON object requested by the user.
